name: Nourishing Lemon & Herb Chicken Soup
steps: Finely chop the dill and parsley, including the stalks! Peel and cut the carrot into thin matchsticks (or very finely dice). Finely slice the celery and grate the garlic.

Add the dill, parsley, ditalini (any other small pasta shape will do!), carrot, garlic and celery to a freezer safe Tupperware along with the chicken stock and the zest of the lemon. Top with the chicken breast, seasoning it with salt and pepper, then pop into the freezer until ready to use.
When you're ready to cook, transfer the frozen contents of the Tupperware into a saucepan set over a medium heat. Cover with a lid, allow to melt. Then simmer the soup for 10 mins.
Flip the chicken and cook for another 5 mins, until the chicken is cooked through. Once cooked, remove the chicken from the pan and shred into bite-sized pieces and add back into the soup.
Season to taste with salt, pepper and lemon juice. Sprinkle over some parm and chilli flakes if you fancy too and dish up.
